title: Core consumed-through marker
description: One line of <store>/core/consumed.jsonl: the generation of the core log a session read through, at its start or after a compaction (core.Log.Pull), appended only when it moved. Between two pulls the session reads the core through its latest marker, and a shared curated edit is checked against it. Source: memory/core/log.go (Marker, Pull, Consumed) and lisp/src/core.lisp.
